id.description: ID of the action to run.

key.description: Key of the action to run. If the same key exists across multiple integrations, also pass `integrationId`, `integrationKey`, or `connectionId` so we know which one you mean.

api.description: Inline HTTP request spec, sent through the resolved connection's auth layer and base URL. Pair with `connectionId`, `connectionKey`, `integrationId`, or `integrationKey` to pick the connection.

path.description: Path appended to the connection's base URL, e.g. `/v2/users/me`. Required.

body.description: Request body. For JSON APIs, pass a plain object.

code.description: Inline JavaScript executed in a sandbox. The module must export a function that receives `{ input, membrane, ... }`. Its return value becomes the action output.

integrationId.description: ID of the integration to run the action on. When `key` is provided, looks up the action within this integration. When no connection is specified, runs against this integration's default connection.

integrationKey.description: Key of the integration to run the action on. When `key` is provided, looks up the action within this integration. When no connection is specified, runs against this integration's default connection.

connectionId.description: ID of the connection to run the action against. If a connection-level version of the action exists on this connection, that version is used; otherwise the integration-level or universal action is used.

connectionKey.description: Key of the connection to run the action against. Use when you have a stable key for the connection instead of an ID.

input.description: Input passed to the action, matching its input schema.

meta.description: Arbitrary metadata stored on the action run log.
